text: MCP says "space" everywhere instead of "graph"; agents are nudged to descend into contributing spaces, not rise
description: Felix 2026-11-24: "in MCP things are still called graph. They should be called idea spaces or just spaces consistently." And: an agent may descend into spaces that contribute to its own (linked repos) but should not rise into spaces its own contributes to; imply gently, don't enforce.

status.comment: Every MCP tool takes `space` (old `graph` and `projectPath` still accepted at the boundary, argumentsWithSpace). graph_hygiene is now space_hygiene (loop worker and default-loop.md follow). Resource URIs use ?space= (old names accepted), the prompt argument is `space`, and every description, prompt and hook text says space. The one-port server passes ?space=<slug> to the MCP app. The backend's own tRPC field stays `graph` (internal). The direction hint (SPACE_DIRECTION) sits in every `space` parameter description and the MCP README, not enforced. Caught and fixed one real bug on the way: update_ideas forwarded `graph` to update_idea. Evidence: mcp, loop-worker and backend tsc clean; MCP tests 74/74, loop-worker 35/35, backend mcp-proxy + one-port 7/7, hooks contract test PASS (all on Node 22; Node 26 fails on a better-sqlite3 ABI mismatch unrelated to this). Agents need /mcp reconnect to see the new schema.
